note: Accepted losses of fixture -> importer -> ToCycloneDX -> importer. Report, findings, dependencies and the kept VEX statements come back equal.

losses.reason: a converted document is a new document with its own idempotency key (a fresh UUIDv7)

The importer turns a not_affected (or resolved) analysis into a VEX statement and drops the finding; the statement is in importer.Result.VEX, not in the report, so ToCycloneDX, which sees only the report, cannot write it again.
As not_affected: a resolved analysis leaves no finding in the report.
